title: Deck package (.edeck)
description: Logical content of a deck package in format 2. A package is a single zip archive with the extension .edeck (a plain .edeck.json file is also allowed when no media is included). Its entries are the top-level properties of this object: manifest.json, note_types.json, notes.json, cards.json, preset.json and the optional progress.json and media.json. Media binaries live under the media/ prefix and are described by media.json. Unknown additional entries and unknown fields are ignored so that a newer package can still be read; a note that names a note type reference note_types.json does not declare is an error.

^media/.description: A media file named '<sha256>.<ext>'. In a real package this entry is the raw file; when a package is represented as one JSON document the bytes are base64-encoded.

format_version.description: Package format version. This release writes and accepts exactly version 2; a package of any other version is rejected and must be imported with an older release and exported again. schema/README.md records this one-time exception to the usual N-1 compatibility rule.

app_version.description: Version of the exporting application. Informational only; never used for compatibility decisions.

deck.description: Deck metadata that travels with the package.

name.description: Deck name, at most 200 Unicode characters (counted as runes). The create and rename paths enforce the same bound.

description.description: Deck description, at most 2000 Unicode characters (counted as runes).

include_progress.description: Whether progress.json is present. Defaults to false on export.

include_media.description: Whether media entries are present. When false no media/ entries and no media.json are written.

include_reviews.description: Whether the optional review log in progress.json is present. Requires include_progress.

include_weights.description: Whether preset.json carries non-null FSRS weights. Defaults to false on export, because the weights are fitted to the exporting user's own review log. Packages written before this field existed omit it; an importer decides from preset.json's weights value, not from this flag.

exported_by.description: Opaque identifier of the exporting user, present only when progress is included. It lets the importer decide whether the packaged progress belongs to the importer; it is not a database id.

note_types.title: note_types.json
note_types.description: Every note type of the exported deck. Each entry carries a package-local reference; notes.json names that reference and never a database id.

note_type.title: Note type
note_type.description: One note type: its name and its config, which declares the fields and card templates every note of this type uses.

ref.description: Package-local reference used by notes.json. It is not a database id.

name.description: Note type name, unique per deck in the exported instance.

note_type_config.title: Note type config
note_type_config.description: The note type definition: generation kind, the ordered fields, the card templates, CSS and template options.

kind.description: normal generates one card per template; cloze generates one card per cloze number in the fields.

fields.description: Ordered field definitions. A field id is opaque and stable; a note's fields map is keyed by it.

plain_text.description: The stored value is literal text, not HTML to render.

templates.description: Card templates. A template id is opaque and stable; cards.json names it.

notes.title: notes.json
notes.description: Note content, in the order referenced by cards.json and progress.json.

note.title: Note
note.description: One note. Fields maps a field id of the referenced note type to that field's HTML value; every other property is content that lives outside the field map.

note_type.description: Reference to an entry of note_types.json.

fields.description: Field id to HTML value. A field the note leaves empty is written as the empty string.

extra.description: Optional content without a field or column of its own. Any JSON value is preserved.

cards.title: cards.json
cards.description: The presentation form of every note, so that the card set is identical after import. Ids are always remapped; a card points at its note by position.

note_index.description: Zero-based position of the note in notes.json.

template.description: Template id of the note's note type (for example 't-card'), or 'cloze:<n>' for a cloze deletion.

ordinal.description: Order of the card within its note.

deck_path.description: Subdeck path relative to the imported root deck (for example 'Lesson 1::Verbs'); null means the card sits directly in the note's deck.

preset.title: preset.json
preset.description: Scheduling parameters that travel with the package.

desired_retention.description: Target retention rate, the most important FSRS knob. 0.90 is the default.

maximum_interval_days.description: Upper bound on the interval in days.

weights.description: FSRS weights, exactly 21 values. null means the library defaults are used. The exporter writes null unless include_weights was requested, and the importer uses non-null weights only for a new deck and only when apply_weights was requested.

weights_optimized_at.description: When the weights were last optimised, or null. Always null when weights is null.

weights_review_count.description: Number of reviews the weights were fitted on, or null. Always null when weights is null.

progress.title: progress.json
progress.description: Optional. Contains only the exporting user's own scheduling state and, optionally, their review log. An importer must discard it unless the package belongs to that same user.

card_state.title: Card state
card_state.description: One row of per-user scheduling state. The target card is found by (note_index or external_ref, template); entries that cannot be mapped are reported as not applied.

note_index.description: Zero-based position of the note in notes.json.

external_ref.description: Idempotency key of the note, used for matching when present.

template.description: Card template this state belongs to.

review.title: Review log entry
review.description: One review of a card by the exporting user. Ratings and states are integers, matching the FSRS ecosystem log format.

review_day.description: Local review day YYYY-MM-DD, computed with the user's day cutoff.

step_index_before.description: Remaining learning-step cursor before this rating; the only source for restoring it on undo.

due_before.description: Due date before this rating. Kept because burying changes due_at without writing a review row.

media.title: media.json
media.description: Map from sha256 to the media file inside the package and the deck-scoped names that resolve to it.

path.description: Path of the file inside the package.

names.description: Deck-scoped file names that resolve to this sha in the exporting deck. A field's HTML refers to media by these names, so the importer registers them for the target deck.
